@@ -44,6 +47,62 @@
 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

Correctness is bit-for-bit stable so far: the 20- and 320-triangle result hashes match the original executable at 1, 2, and 4 ranks. On the default workload, measured compute time dropped from 1494 ms at one rank to 775 ms at two and 384 ms at four (3.89× speedup), with the same output hash. I’m checking edge cases and auditing collective/error paths before the final review.

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
 // ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}
+

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
 // ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range");
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}
+

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}
