using idx_t = uint32_t;
using val_t = float;

constexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
constexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;
constexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;
constexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)
constexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;
constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;

// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;

// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
using delay_t = uint8_t;

// ============================================================================
// MPI helpers
// ============================================================================

struct MpiContext {
    int rank = 0;
    int size = 1;
    size_t rowBegin = 0;
    size_t rowCount = 0;
    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;

    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }

    void partition(size_t rows) {
        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
            if (isRoot()) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
            }
            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
            std::abort();
        }

        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
        size_t offset = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
            if (r == rank) {
                rowBegin = offset;
                rowCount = count;
            }
            offset += count;
        }
    }
};

void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;

    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
    int length = 0;
    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
    std::abort();
}

// ============================================================================
// Vector and Triangle Types
// ============================================================================

struct Vec3 {
    val_t x, y, z;

}

// ============================================================================
// Room Response Simulation State
// ============================================================================

struct SimulationState {
    size_t numTriangles;
    size_t numTimesteps;

    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)
    // Only the receiver rows owned by this rank are stored for the O(N^2)
    // matrices. coupling contains min(Kij * area[j], 1), the exact invariant
    // used by every propagation timestep.
    std::vector<val_t> coupling;    // Local transfer weights (local N x N)
    std::vector<delay_t> tau;       // Local time delays (local N x N)
    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)
    std::vector<val_t> localDistances;
    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Complete result on rank zero

    uint64_t localNonZeroKij = 0;

    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure

    size_t sourceIndex;

    size_t idxLocal(size_t localI, size_t j) const { return localI * numTriangles + j; }
    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, MpiContext& mpi,
                          int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
    // Generate mesh
    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
    mpi.partition(state.numTriangles);

    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
        printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
    }

    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Building octree...\n");
    state.octree.build(state.triangles);

    // Initialize areas
    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
    }

    // Initialize reflectivity
    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);

    // Initialize distributed matrices and replicated radiosity history.
    state.coupling.resize(mpi.rowCount * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.tau.resize(mpi.rowCount * state.numTriangles, 0);
    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.localDistances.resize(mpi.rowCount, ZERO);
    if (mpi.isRoot()) state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);
}

// ============================================================================
// Precomputation Phase
// ============================================================================

void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Computing distributed form factors (Kij)...\n");
    RandomGenerator rng(42);
    state.localNonZeroKij = 0;

    // Reproduce the sequential random stream at this rank's first row. A pair
    // consumes a fixed number of samples unless it is diagonal or rejected by
    // the normal test before sampling.
    uint64_t samplesBefore = 0;
    if (mpi.rowCount != 0) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < mpi.rowBegin; ++i) {
            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
                if (i != j && state.triangles[i].normal().dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) <= 0.99f) {
                    samplesBefore += RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    rng.discard(samplesBefore);

    for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
        const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            const val_t kij = computeKij(i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);
            if (kij > EPSILON) ++state.localNonZeroKij;
            state.coupling[state.idxLocal(localI, j)] = std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE);
        }
    }
}

void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Computing distributed time delays (Tau)...\n");

    for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
        const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            state.tau[state.idxLocal(localI, j)] = static_cast<delay_t>(
                computeTau(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]));
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
// ============================================================================

void runSimulation(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Running distributed wave propagation simulation...\n");

    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
        for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
            const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
            val_t sumB = ZERO;

            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
                if (i == j) continue;

                const delay_t tauij = state.tau[state.idxLocal(localI, j)];

                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i
                if (t < static_cast<size_t>(tauij)) continue;

                const val_t transfer = state.coupling[state.idxLocal(localI, j)];
                if (transfer <= ZERO) continue;

                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred
                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);
                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];
                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;

                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity
                sumB += transfer * radJ;
            }

            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission
            const val_t emission = (t < state.numTimesteps / 2 && i == state.sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + emission;
        }

        // Delays between distinct triangle centers are always positive, so only
        // the completed row is needed by the next timestep.
        val_t* timestepRow = state.radB.data() + t * state.numTriangles;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_FLOAT,
                                timestepRow, mpi.rowCounts.data(),
                                mpi.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT,
                                MPI_COMM_WORLD),
                 "MPI_Allgatherv(radiosity)");

        if (mpi.isRoot() && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {
            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
// ============================================================================

void computeDistances(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Computing distributed distances via cross-correlation...\n");

    for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
        const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;
        int bestT = 0;

        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay
        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
            val_t sum = ZERO;

            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {
                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];
                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];
                sum += pS * pB;
            }

            if (sum > maxCorr) {
                maxCorr = sum;
                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);
            }
        }

        state.localDistances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);
    }

    mpiCheck(MPI_Gatherv(state.localDistances.data(), static_cast<int>(mpi.rowCount), MPI_FLOAT,
                         mpi.isRoot() ? state.distances.data() : nullptr,
                         mpi.rowCounts.data(), mpi.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT,
                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
             "MPI_Gatherv(distances)");
}

// ============================================================================
// Validation
// ============================================================================

bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
    uint64_t nonZeroKij = 0;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Reduce(&state.localNonZeroKij, &nonZeroKij, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
                        MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
             "MPI_Reduce(non-zero Kij)");

    int valid = 1;
    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
        printf("\nValidation:\n");

        bool allNonNegative = true;
        val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
    printf("  -o           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    const int initError = MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);
    if (initError != MPI_SUCCESS) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "Unable to initialize MPI\n");
        return 1;
    }

    MpiContext mpi;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN),
             "MPI_Comm_set_errhandler");
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi.rank), "MPI_Comm_rank");
    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi.size), "MPI_Comm_size");

    int targetTriangles = 320;
    int timesteps = 50;
    int sourceIdx = 0;
    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;

    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-t") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            if (mpi.isRoot()) printUsage(argv[0]);
            return MPI_Finalize() == MPI_SUCCESS ? 0 : 1;
        } else {
            if (mpi.isRoot()) {
                printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
                printUsage(argv[0]);
            }
            MPI_Finalize();
            return 1;
        }
    }

    const int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);

    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
        printf("Room Response Simulation Benchmark\n");
        printf("===================================\n");
        printf("MPI ranks: %d\n", mpi.size);
        printf("Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\n", targetTriangles, subdivisions);
        printf("Timesteps: %d\n", timesteps);
        printf("Source triangle: %d\n", sourceIdx);
        printf("Reflectivity: %.2f\n", reflectivity);
        printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
        printf("\n");
    }

    // Initialize
    SimulationState state;
    initializeSimulation(state, mpi, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),
                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);

    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
        printf("Rows per rank: %zu-%zu\n\n",
               state.numTriangles / static_cast<size_t>(mpi.size),
               (state.numTriangles + static_cast<size_t>(mpi.size) - 1) /
                   static_cast<size_t>(mpi.size));
    }

    auto timePhase = [&](auto&& operation) {
        mpiCheck(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD), "MPI_Barrier(phase start)");
        const double start = MPI_Wtime();
        operation();
        const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
        double maximumElapsed = 0.0;
        mpiCheck(MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &maximumElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
                            0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
                 "MPI_Reduce(phase time)");
        return maximumElapsed;
    };

    // Precomputation
    const double preSeconds = timePhase([&] {
        computeTimeDelays(state, mpi);
        computeFormFactors(state, mpi);
    });
    const long preDuration = static_cast<long>(preSeconds * 1000.0);
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Precomputation time: %ld ms\n\n", preDuration);

    // Simulation
    const double simSeconds = timePhase([&] { runSimulation(state, mpi); });
    const long simDuration = static_cast<long>(simSeconds * 1000.0);
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Simulation time: %ld ms\n\n", simDuration);

    // Distance computation
    const double distSeconds = timePhase([&] { computeDistances(state, mpi); });
    const long distDuration = static_cast<long>(distSeconds * 1000.0);
    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Distance computation time: %ld ms\n\n", distDuration);

    // Total time
    const long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;

    // Performance metrics
    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;
    const size_t t = state.numTimesteps;
    const double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n) * static_cast<double>(n);
    const double simOps = kijOps * static_cast<double>(t);
    const double distOps = static_cast<double>(n) * static_cast<double>(t) *
                           static_cast<double>(t);

    // Memory usage
    const uint64_t localMem =
        static_cast<uint64_t>(mpi.rowCount) * n * (sizeof(val_t) + sizeof(delay_t)) +
        static_cast<uint64_t>(t) * n * sizeof(val_t);
    uint64_t maxMem = 0;
    mpiCheck(MPI_Reduce(&localMem, &maxMem, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, MPI_MAX,
                        0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
             "MPI_Reduce(memory)");

    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
        printf("Total computation time: %ld ms\n", totalTime);
        printf("\nPerformance:\n");
        printf("  MPI ranks: %d\n", mpi.size);
        printf("  Triangles: %zu\n", n);
        printf("  Timesteps: %zu\n", t);
        printf("  Form factor computations: %.2e\n", kijOps);
        printf("  Simulation operations: %.2e\n", simOps);
        printf("  Distance computations: %.2e\n", distOps);
        printf("  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\n",
               static_cast<double>(totalTime) / static_cast<double>(n));
        printf("  Memory usage (maximum rank): %.2f MB\n",
               static_cast<double>(maxMem) / (1024.0 * 1024.0));

        const uint64_t hash = computeHash(state);
        printf("  Result hash: %016" PRIX64 "\n\n", hash);
    }
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (mpi.isRoot() && printResults) {
        // Convert distances to double for output
        std::vector<double> distData(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end());
        print_results(distData, "Distances");
    }

    // Validation
    int exitCode = 0;
    if (validate && !validateResults(state, mpi)) exitCode = 1;

    return MPI_Finalize() == MPI_SUCCESS ? exitCode : 1;
}

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

    48	// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
    49	// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
    50	// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
    51	constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
    52	
    53	// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
    54	// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
    55	using delay_t = uint8_t;

    57	// ============================================================================
    58	// MPI helpers
    59	// ============================================================================
    60	
    61	struct MpiContext {
    62	    int rank = 0;
    63	    int size = 1;
    64	    size_t rowBegin = 0;
    65	    size_t rowCount = 0;
    66	    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
    67	    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
    68	
    69	    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
    70	
    71	    void partition(size_t rows) {
    72	        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
    73	            if (isRoot()) {
    74	                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
    75	            }
    76	            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
    77	            std::abort();
    78	        }
    79	
    80	        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
    81	        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
    82	        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
    83	        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
    84	        size_t offset = 0;
    85	        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
    86	            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
    87	            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
    88	            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
    89	            if (r == rank) {
    90	                rowBegin = offset;
    91	                rowCount = count;
    92	            }
    93	            offset += count;
    94	        }
    95	    }
    96	};
    97	
    98	void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
    99	    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
   100	
   101	    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
   102	    int length = 0;
   103	    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
   104	    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
   105	    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
   106	    std::abort();
   107	}

   585	
   586	struct SimulationState {
   587	    size_t numTriangles;
   588	    size_t numTimesteps;
   589	
   590	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   591	    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
   592	    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)
   593	    // Only the receiver rows owned by this rank are stored for the O(N^2)
   594	    // matrices. coupling contains min(Kij * area[j], 1), the exact invariant
   595	    // used by every propagation timestep.
   596	    std::vector<val_t> coupling;    // Local transfer weights (local N x N)
   597	    std::vector<delay_t> tau;       // Local time delays (local N x N)
   598	    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)
   599	    std::vector<val_t> localDistances;
   600	    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Complete result on rank zero
   601	
   602	    uint64_t localNonZeroKij = 0;
   603	
   604	    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure
   605	
   606	    size_t sourceIndex;
   607	
   608	    size_t idxLocal(size_t localI, size_t j) const { return localI * numTriangles + j; }
   609	    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
   610	};

   612	// ============================================================================
   613	// Initialization
   614	// ============================================================================
   615	
   616	void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, MpiContext& mpi,
   617	                          int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
   618	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
   619	    // Generate mesh
   620	    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
   621	    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
   622	    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
   623	    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
   624	    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
   625	    mpi.partition(state.numTriangles);
   626	
   627	    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
   628	        printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
   629	    }
   630	
   631	    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
   632	    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Building octree...\n");
   633	    state.octree.build(state.triangles);
   634	
   635	    // Initialize areas
   636	    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
   637	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   638	        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
   639	    }
   640	
   641	    // Initialize reflectivity
   642	    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);
   643	
   644	    // Initialize distributed matrices and replicated radiosity history.
   645	    state.coupling.resize(mpi.rowCount * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
   646	    state.tau.resize(mpi.rowCount * state.numTriangles, 0);
   647	    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
   648	    state.localDistances.resize(mpi.rowCount, ZERO);
   649	    if (mpi.isRoot()) state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);
   650	}
   651	
   652	// ============================================================================
   653	// Precomputation Phase
   654	// ============================================================================
   655	
   656	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
   657	    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Computing distributed form factors (Kij)...\n");
   658	    RandomGenerator rng(42);
   659	    state.localNonZeroKij = 0;
   660	
   661	    // Reproduce the sequential random stream at this rank's first row. A pair
   662	    // consumes a fixed number of samples unless it is diagonal or rejected by
   663	    // the normal test before sampling.
   664	    uint64_t samplesBefore = 0;
   665	    if (mpi.rowCount != 0) {
   666	        for (size_t i = 0; i < mpi.rowBegin; ++i) {
   667	            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
   668	                if (i != j && state.triangles[i].normal().dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) <= 0.99f) {
   669	                    samplesBefore += RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR;
   670	                }
   671	            }
   672	        }
   673	    }
   674	    rng.discard(samplesBefore);
   675	
   676	    for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
   677	        const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
   678	        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
   679	            if (i == j) continue;
   680	            const val_t kij = computeKij(i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);
   681	            if (kij > EPSILON) ++state.localNonZeroKij;
   682	            state.coupling[state.idxLocal(localI, j)] = std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE);
   683	        }
   684	    }
   685	}
   686	
   687	void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
   688	    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Computing distributed time delays (Tau)...\n");
   689	
   690	    for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
   691	        const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
   692	        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
   693	            if (i == j) continue;
   694	            state.tau[state.idxLocal(localI, j)] = static_cast<delay_t>(
   695	                computeTau(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]));
   696	        }
   697	    }
   698	}
   699	
   700	// ============================================================================
   701	// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
   702	// ============================================================================
   703	
   704	void runSimulation(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
   705	    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Running distributed wave propagation simulation...\n");
   706	
   707	    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
   708	        for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
   709	            const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
   710	            val_t sumB = ZERO;
   711	
   712	            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
   713	                if (i == j) continue;
   714	
   715	                const delay_t tauij = state.tau[state.idxLocal(localI, j)];
   716	
   717	                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i
   718	                if (t < static_cast<size_t>(tauij)) continue;
   719	
   720	                const val_t transfer = state.coupling[state.idxLocal(localI, j)];
   721	                if (transfer <= ZERO) continue;
   722	
   723	                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred
   724	                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);
   725	                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];
   726	                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;
   727	
   728	                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity
   729	                sumB += transfer * radJ;
   730	            }
   731	
   732	            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission
   733	            const val_t emission = (t < state.numTimesteps / 2 && i == state.sourceIndex) ? ONE : ZERO;
   734	            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + emission;
   735	        }
   736	
   737	        // Delays between distinct triangle centers are always positive, so only
   738	        // the completed row is needed by the next timestep.
   739	        val_t* timestepRow = state.radB.data() + t * state.numTriangles;
   740	        mpiCheck(MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_FLOAT,
   741	                                timestepRow, mpi.rowCounts.data(),
   742	                                mpi.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT,
   743	                                MPI_COMM_WORLD),
   744	                 "MPI_Allgatherv(radiosity)");
   745	
   746	        if (mpi.isRoot() && ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps)) {
   747	            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
   748	        }
   749	    }
   750	}
   751	
   752	// ============================================================================
   753	// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
   754	// ============================================================================
   755	
   756	void computeDistances(SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
   757	    if (mpi.isRoot()) printf("Computing distributed distances via cross-correlation...\n");
   758	
   759	    for (size_t localI = 0; localI < mpi.rowCount; ++localI) {
   760	        const size_t i = mpi.rowBegin + localI;
   761	        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;
   762	        int bestT = 0;
   763	
   764	        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay
   765	        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
   766	            val_t sum = ZERO;
   767	
   768	            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {
   769	                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];
   770	                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];
   771	                sum += pS * pB;
   772	            }
   773	
   774	            if (sum > maxCorr) {
   775	                maxCorr = sum;
   776	                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);
   777	            }
   778	        }
   779	
   780	        state.localDistances[localI] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);
   781	    }
   782	
   783	    mpiCheck(MPI_Gatherv(state.localDistances.data(), static_cast<int>(mpi.rowCount), MPI_FLOAT,
   784	                         mpi.isRoot() ? state.distances.data() : nullptr,
   785	                         mpi.rowCounts.data(), mpi.rowDisplacements.data(), MPI_FLOAT,
   786	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
   787	             "MPI_Gatherv(distances)");
   788	}
   789	
   790	// ============================================================================
   791	// Validation
   792	// ============================================================================
   793	
   794	bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, const MpiContext& mpi) {
   795	    uint64_t nonZeroKij = 0;
   796	    mpiCheck(MPI_Reduce(&state.localNonZeroKij, &nonZeroKij, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
   797	                        MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD),
   798	             "MPI_Reduce(non-zero Kij)");
   799	
   800	    int valid = 1;
   801	    if (mpi.isRoot()) {
   802	        printf("\nValidation:\n");
   803

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}

Key changes:

- Balanced row-wise distribution of form factors, delays, simulation, and cross-correlation.
- Distributed \(O(N^2)\) matrix storage with compact delays and precomputed transfer weights.
- One `MPI_Allgatherv` per timestep; final distances gathered to rank zero.
- Original RNG stream preserved exactly across rank counts.
- Root-only output and slowest-rank MPI timing.
- Executable remains `roomsim`; MPI is now required.

Verification:

- Exact original hashes at 1, 2, and 4 ranks.
- Validation passes with 21 ranks on 20 triangles, including zero-row ranks.
- Clean warning-free build and sanitizer pass.
- 1,280-triangle benchmark: 26.899 s on one rank versus 6.791 s on four ranks—3.96× speedup with identical hash.
- No new workspace files created.

 constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
 constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;
 
+// Each ray samples two points, and each point consumes two uniform random values.
+// This is used to position every MPI rank at the same point in the original global
+// random stream, making the result independent of the number of ranks.
+constexpr uint64_t RNG_SAMPLES_PER_PAIR = 4ULL * NUM_RAYS;
+
+// The room has diameter 20 and inverse wave speed 2, so all delays fit in a byte.
+// Keeping delays compact improves the bandwidth-bound propagation phase.
+using delay_t = uint8_t;
+
+// ============================================================================
+// MPI helpers
+// ============================================================================
+
+struct MpiContext {
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    size_t rowBegin = 0;
+    size_t rowCount = 0;
+    std::vector<int> rowCounts;
+    std::vector<int> rowDisplacements;
+
+    bool isRoot() const { return rank == 0; }
+
+    void partition(size_t rows) {
+        if (rows > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+            if (isRoot()) {
+                std::fprintf(stderr, "Triangle count exceeds MPI collective count range\n");
+            }
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        rowCounts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        rowDisplacements.resize(static_cast<size_t>(size));
+        const size_t quotient = rows / static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        const size_t remainder = rows % static_cast<size_t>(size);
+        size_t offset = 0;
+        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {
+            const size_t count = quotient + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+            rowCounts[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(count);
+            rowDisplacements[static_cast<size_t>(r)] = static_cast<int>(offset);
+            if (r == rank) {
+                rowBegin = offset;
+                rowCount = count;
+            }
+            offset += count;
+        }
+    }
+};
+
+void mpiCheck(int error, const char* operation) {
+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING];
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI failure in %s: %.*s\n", operation, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}
